name: slack_post_message
title: Post a Slack message
description:
Post a message to a Slack channel, direct message or thread as the signed-in user, through their connected Slack account (a user token with chat:write; Web API chat.postMessage). Writes to Slack; not idempotent.
Returns: ok, channel (ID), ts (message timestamp, usable as thread_ts for replies) and text.
Inputs (* required): channel* (channel ID such as C0123..., name such as #general, or a user ID for a DM); text* (1-40,000 characters, Slack mrkdwn); thread_ts (parent message ts to reply in its thread, e.g. 1712345678.000100).
Runs only for a signed-in SAJHA user; when the account is not linked, or lacks the scope, the call returns a request to connect it with a link instead of a result.
Example: {"channel": "#general", "text": "Deploy finished at 14:05 UTC."}

channel.description: Channel ID (C0123...) or name (#general), or a user ID for a DM

thread_ts.description: Reply in this thread (the parent message ts)

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Posts as the caller; marked destructive so Ask SAJHA and MCP clients confirm first.
